_comment: Stage 1 verdict thresholds, registered in writing BEFORE the first run of the array named. Changing any value is a new version of the model, not a new reading of the same one. Array A has no entry: its run happened before this file existed, so its result is a report and not a verdict, and adding thresholds afterwards would be choosing them with the answers already visible.

array_b._baseline: Every skill figure is measured against the base rate of the individual grid cell, not a single pooled rate. A model that had only learned the shape of the grid would beat a pooled rate without knowing anything about sweeps.
